summary: Basic principles and methods of medical practice

sections.title: Medical Fundamentals Chapter One
sections.originalText: 医道之大，莫过于阴阳。阴阳者，天地之道也，万物之纲纪。
sections.translation: The great way of medicine is none other than yin and yang. Yin and yang are the way of heaven and earth, the principle of all things.
sections.interpretation: This chapter establishes yin-yang theory as the fundamental principle of Chinese medicine.

keyConcepts.description: The basic principles and theoretical foundations of Chinese medicine
